
# Antibiotics

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
```

## Load info of abx dataset
```{r, warning=F,  message=FALSE}
antib<-read.csv("../Data/antib.csv")
```

## Effects of abx on microbiome - suppl fig 1c
```{r, warning=F,  message=FALSE}
samples_abx<-samples %>% 
  left_join(antib %>% mutate(UPN=as.character(UPN))) %>% 
  inner_join(asv_alpha) %>% 
   mutate(antibiotics=ifelse(is.na(result), "no", result)) %>%
  mutate(exposed_sample=ifelse(antibiotics!="no" & sample_day>(start_relative), "exposed", "not exposed")) %>% 
  mutate(exposed_sample=ifelse(is.na(exposed_sample), "not exposed", exposed_sample)) %>% # there is no NA actually
  mutate(time_sample_dif_start=as.integer(start_relative-sample_day)) %>% 
  mutate(time_sample_dif_end=as.integer(end_relative-sample_day)) %>% 
  filter((time_sample_dif_end>=-15 | time_sample_dif_start >=-15) & 
           (time_sample_dif_end<=15 | time_sample_dif_start <=15 )) 
  

samples_abx_paired2 <- samples_abx %>%
  group_by(UPN) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(exposed_sample)>=2) %>%
  ungroup()

samples_abx_paired2$exposed_sample<-factor(samples_abx_paired2$exposed_sample, levels=c("not exposed", "exposed"))

ggpaired(samples_abx_paired2, x="exposed_sample",y="simpson_reciprocal",id="UPN", color = "exposed_sample", 
         line.color = "grey70",
  line.size = 0.4,
  palette = c("exposed" = "#a6611a","not exposed" = "#2E9FDF" ) ) +
  ylab("a-diversity") +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    comparisons = list(c("exposed", "not exposed")),
    label = "p.format",
    label.y = 25
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15))

ggsave("../Figures/suppl_fig1c.pdf", width=5, height=4, dpi=150)

```

## Are antibiotics associated with PFS? Fig 1b 
```{r, warning=F,  message=FALSE}
cohort_antibiotics<-cohort %>% 
  left_join(antib) %>%
    mutate(abx_pert2=ifelse(abx_pert=="high/mod", "high/mod", "no/low")) %>%
  mutate(abx_pert2=ifelse(is.na(abx_pert), "no/low", abx_pert2)) %>%
  group_by(UPN)%>%
  add_count() 

cohort_antibiotics$abx_pert2<-factor(cohort_antibiotics$abx_pert2, levels=c("no/low", "high/mod"))
fit<-survfit(Surv(VPFS_upd, VRelapse)~abx_pert2, data=cohort_antibiotics)
p<-ggsurvplot(fit, data=cohort_antibiotics,
           palette = c("#ef8a62","#999999","#a6611a","#2166AC"),
           # palette = c( "#E7B800", "#2E9FDF","#a6611a","#2166AC"),

           conf.int=TRUE,
           pval=TRUE,
           risk.table = T,
           xlim = c(0,36), 
           break.x.by = 6)
# if priorrelapse is in formula
  p$plot <- p$plot +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
    fill  = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )
ggsave("../Data/fig1b_plot.pdf",p$plot, height=4, width=5)

# multi varaiates
formula_m <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(VPFS_upd, VRelapse) ~ abx_pert2+MYCN+PriorRelapse+age_vaccine"))
fit_cox <- coxph(
  formula_m,
  data = cohort_antibiotics
)

```

## Evaluate exposure to antibiotics and titers:fig1c
```{r,  message=FALSE}
df<-cohort_antibiotics %>% inner_join(titers[,c("UPN", "c4_titer","c4_high_median" )], by="UPN") %>% 
  mutate(log_titer=log(c4_titer+1)) %>% 
  left_join(glucan[,c("UPN","group")], by="UPN")


df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=abx_pert2, y=c4_titer, color=abx_pert2))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA, width=0.4)+
  geom_jitter(width=0.4, alpha=0.6)+
  geom_smooth(method="lm")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#ef8a62","#999999"))+
  stat_compare_means(comparisons=list(c("high/mod", "no/low")), method = "wilcox.test")+
  labs(y="Anti-GD2 IgG")
 
ggsave("../Data/fig1c.pdf", width=3, height=3.5, dpi=150)  

```


## Are baseline samples exposed to antibiotics? - Suppl fig 1
```{r, warning=F,  message=FALSE}
baseline_sample_abx<-read.csv("../Data/03_baseline_samples_abxfiltered.csv")

baseline_sample_abx %>% mutate(UPN=as.character(UPN)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sample_day, y=UPN, color=exposed_sample)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7)+
  geom_line(aes(group=UPN), alpha=.6)+
  ylab("Patients")+
  xlab("Time from vaccine entry")+
    theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.y=element_blank())+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#56B4E9", "#009E73", "grey2","#ef8a62" ))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))
ggsave("../Data/suppl_fig1d.pdf", height=3.5, width=6)

```
